name: SIM & UICC Security
description: Ability to assess the security of SIM cards, USIMs, and UICC platforms. Covers SIM application analysis, STK (SIM Toolkit) security, OTA (Over-The-Air) update mechanism assessment, SIM jacking and swap attack vectors, eSIM/eUICC provisioning security, and extraction of SIM-stored credentials and subscriber data for forensic analysis.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to SIM or UICC security analysis

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands SIM card architecture and known security concerns
evidence: Can describe the SIM/USIM/UICC architecture and file system structure
Understands the role of Ki, OPc, and authentication key material
Completed training on SIM security and known attack vectors (SIM jacking, OTA attacks)

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reads SIM card contents and performs basic analysis under supervision
evidence: Read SIM file system contents (ICCID, IMSI, MSISDN, LOCI) using PC/SC readers under guidance
Analyzed SIM Toolkit applications and their permission profiles under supervision
Examined OTA SMS update mechanisms and security configurations with assistance

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently performs SIM security assessments and forensic data extraction
evidence: Independently assessed SIM/USIM security for 3+ engagements
Performed forensic extraction of subscriber data, location history, and stored SMS from SIM cards
Evaluated SIM OTA update security including SMS-PP and BIP channels
Produced reports documenting SIM security findings with evidence and remediation

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses advanced SIM platforms including eSIM; develops SIM analysis tools
evidence: Assessed eSIM/eUICC remote provisioning security and profile management
Analyzed Java Card applets running on UICC platforms for vulnerabilities
Developed custom SIM analysis scripts and automated extraction tools
Reviews SIM assessment reports and mentors junior analysts

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Recognized authority on SIM/UICC security; discovers vulnerabilities in SIM platforms
evidence: Published research on SIM/UICC security vulnerabilities or analysis techniques
Discovered novel vulnerabilities in SIM platforms, OTA mechanisms, or eSIM provisioning
Authored the lab's SIM security assessment methodology
Trains teams on SIM security and advises operators on SIM platform hardening

assessment_methods.description: Perform a SIM security assessment: extract file system contents, analyze STK applications, evaluate OTA security, and produce a findings report
Review SIM security assessment reports for extraction completeness and finding accuracy
